We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle CDP/Unity Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on working with Oracle's suite of applications and tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, marketing automation, and customer experience solutions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations
* Analyzing client needs to develop tailored software solutions that enhance customer experience and satisfaction
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications
* Managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization using Oracle's suite of tools
* Building meaningful client connections and fostering relationships to understand and anticipate client needs
* Navigating complex situations and using critical thinking to solve problems and generate new ideas
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including PwC's code of conduct and independence requirements
* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
* Collaborating with teams to deliver quality and strategic objectives in business application consulting
* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery


 What You Must Have
   

  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands\-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end\-to\-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, administrators, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.


**Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement\-gathering and solution\-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source\-to\-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data\-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end\-to\-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross\-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.


**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**
* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source\-to\-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data\-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub\-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third\-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data\-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity\-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data\-science processes, and integrations.

title: Software Development Engineer II, WW Returns and ReCommerce
description:
**Description**
 Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR\&R) at Amazon.com.
   

  

 WW R\&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR\&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned \& damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.
   

  

 Amazon WW R\&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re\-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world\-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
   

  

 As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C\+\+, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for software engineers with 2\+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
   

  

 Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WW R\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce team!

description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a SAP CPI \- PIPO professional, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions within an organization. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward isn’t clear.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of our Technology Consulting network, specifically within our SAP practice. You will engage with clients to analyze their needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. This opportunity allows you to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts and interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyzing client needs to implement and support SAP software solutions effectively
* Managing the installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
* Developing and maintaining SAP systems to optimize operational efficiency for clients
* Providing training and support to clients for seamless integration and utilization of SAP applications
* Collaborating with teams to design and execute strategic technology plans using SAP solutions
* Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for custom development and enhancements
* Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to deliver insightful data visualizations and user experiences
* Engaging in process improvement and optimization initiatives to enhance client outcomes
* Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality solutions
* Mentoring junior team members to foster growth and technical skills development


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience

description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
   

  

 DESCRIPTION:
   

  

 Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi\-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect, design, develop, and deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions for bioprocessing, industrial automation, instrumentation, and process applications.
* Develop reusable software components, backend services, REST APIs, integration layers, data pipelines, libraries, and reference architectures for use across multiple products and programs.
* Integrate software applications with equipment, instruments, PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, historians, MES, sensors, actuators, and enterprise/manufacturing systems using industrial communication technologies.
* Design solutions for acquisition, processing, storage, visualization, and analysis of equipment, sensor, process, operational, and time\-series data.
* Drive software engineering best practices including object\-oriented design, design patterns, code reviews, automated testing, source control, CI/CD, DevOps, deployment, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure software solutions address cybersecurity, data integrity, validation, software quality, reliability, and regulatory requirements for connected and regulated systems.
* Identify and implement practical AI/ML, Generative AI, and advanced analytics opportunities for process monitoring, anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive maintenance, troubleshooting, engineering productivity, knowledge retrieval, and decision support.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture guidance, design reviews, technology evaluation, mentoring, troubleshooting, and technical decision\-making.
* Lead solutions from architecture and proof\-of\-concept through productization, testing, deployment, and lifecycle support while driving reuse, standardization, automation, and engineering productivity


**Required Qualifications**
* 9–14 years of relevant experience in software engineering, industrial/process automation, electronics or electrical engineering, or related disciplines.
* Strong hands\-on development experience in one or more languages such as C\#, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Strong knowledge of software architecture, object\-oriented design, design patterns, multithreading, networking, APIs, data structures, system integration, and scalable application design.
* Experience developing backend services, REST APIs, data pipelines, and applications using relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Strong understanding of industrial/process automation, process control, instrumentation, sensors, actuators, control loops, process variables, and data acquisition.
* Working knowledge of PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, historians, MES and industrial protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, or MQTT.
* Experience with automated testing, source control, CI/CD, build automation, deployment, and modern DevOps practices.
* Strong architecture, troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business and product requirements into secure and scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI, including anomaly detection, predictive analytics, LLMs, RAG, intelligent assistants, AI governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience in bioprocessing, life sciences, pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, laboratory/instrumentation products, or process industries is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of GxP, validation, data integrity, PAT, APC, soft sensors, digital twins, or model\-based approaches is an advantage.

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role provides advanced\-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the analysis, design, development, implementation, and support of complex applications, services, and databases. Develop scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions while integrating third\-party products and enterprise platforms to meet business and technology objectives.
* Translate business and technical requirements into high\-quality software solutions for new development and enhancement initiatives. Design, develop, test, and deploy application components utilizing modern software engineering practices, with a strong emphasis on automation, code quality, reusability, and maintainability.

* Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and testing activities throughout the development lifecycle to identify risks, ensure solution quality, and drive continuous improvement. Conduct systems analysis and effectively communicate technical considerations, trade\-offs, and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Develop a strong understanding of business processes, client needs, and operational workflows. Leverage knowledge of Vanguard's technology ecosystem, applications, and integrated platforms to deliver solutions that align technology investments with business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Partner closely with cross\-functional teams including Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Engineers, QA partners, and business stakeholders to deliver business value. Communicate technical concepts, project status, and system impacts effectively to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
* Ensure all solutions adhere to Information Technology, Information Security, Risk Management, and Regulatory Compliance standards. Incorporate secure coding practices, architectural guidelines, and operational controls into all phases of development while validating that deliverables meet established requirements and governance expectations.
* Contribute to ongoing modernization efforts, operational excellence initiatives, and strategic technology programs. Support a portfolio of enterprise applications through a combination of maintenance, enhancements, problem resolution, and innovation opportunities while participating in special projects and additional responsibilities as needed.

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back\-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams.

* Proficiency in DevOps concepts, tools and continuous delivery pipelines, specifically Git and GitHub

title: Software Development Engineer II, FinTech, FinTech
description:
**Description**
 Are you looking for an opportunity that will help revolutionize the way big data sets are cataloged, discovered and searched for one of the world’s largest financial data systems? Are you interested in innovating and building platforms that use machine learning to identify anomalies and provide insights across billions of financial transactions? Does the prospect of working with the top engineering talent get you charged up? If so, Amazon Finance Technology (FinTech) is for you!
   

  

 Amazon Finance Technology is seeking a talented Software Development Engineer to work on FinTech Treasury. In this role, you will build treasury solutions that manage bank balances, cash flows, and cash\-impacting transactions, supporting financial movements across all Amazon businesses. You will build a next\-generation, horizontally scalable platform that will transact hundreds of billions of dollars each year as Amazon grows into a multi\-trillion\-dollar company. The platform supports banking and financial services capabilities that enable cash flow tracking and payment execution across Amazon’s global operations. You should be comfortable working with highly abstracted, extensible systems in a multi\-tenant, microservice\-oriented architecture.
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer in Finance Technology, you will be responsible for driving implementation decisions, delivering functional components, and mentoring junior engineers to develop logical \& maintainable software that meets high standards of quality and abstraction.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned engineer. In this position, you will play a major role in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex big data applications. You will push your design and architecture limits by inventing and simplifying complex problems. You have strong verbal and written communication skills, are self\-driven, and can deliver high quality results in a fast\-paced environment. You will work with Amazon engineering and business teams across the globe in planning, designing, executing and implementing this new platform.
   

  

 This is a brand\-new platform we are building. We are currently in the stage of defining the architecture and high\-level design. So, this is your chance to build this platform from scratch.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

This function is of paramount importance to the company, as it underpins Amazon's ability to effectively manage its finances and drive continued expansion.

Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real\-time. We need someone to design and develop services that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to be part of a mission\-critical initiative with significant organizational visibility and impact.

Your technical expertise and innovative thinking will be instrumental in ensuring the foundational services are designed with scalability, reliability, and performance in mind for Amazon.
   

  

 Adopting Latest Technology: You will have the chance to work with the latest technologies, frameworks, and tools to build these foundational services. This includes leveraging advancements in areas such as cloud computing, distributed systems, data processing, and real\-time analytics.

You will be challenged to tackle complex problems related to data processing, queuing, and real\-time analytics.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional and Senior Engineer Collaboration: You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, and accountants. You will also be working directly with multiple Principal Engineers and presenting your work to Senior Principal Engineers. This experience will give you the opportunities and visibility to help build the required leadership skills to enhance your career.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define high level and low level design for software solutions using the latest AWS technology in a large distributed environment.

 At the heart of FinTech's mission is the Financial Close Systems team, which builds and operates the technologies to support accurate internal and external financial reporting . The work of the Close systems team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical month end close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 We are the Global KYC and Onboarding squad in the Servicing department and we have a mission: to enable teams at Wise to expand and fine\-tune the business in a "config change" manner all across the globe, while remaining compliant and safe for the customers. There are three teams in the squad: Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification and Wise Platform Verification (our B2B platform).
   

  

 The scale we operate at: In FY2025, 15\.6 million people and businesses used Wise, we onboarded over 5\.9 million new customers (\~500k/month), and moved £145\.2bn across borders (\~£400m/day) across 160\+ countries and 40\+ currencies. Our verification systems aren't supporting tools — they're core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies, and evolving threat patterns.
   

  

 All of the teams are diverse, cross\-functional groups passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together backend and frontend engineers, mobile developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our teams are responsible for the critical verification journeys that business and personal customers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high ownership in a bottom\-up, transparent culture, make data\-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. Right now we're focused on building KYC/FinCrime as a configuration\-driven product, refactoring and building new scalable microservice systems, and increasing automation using ML/AI where it genuinely improves decisioning, review quality, and operational efficiency — with safe fallbacks and clear observability. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.
   

  

 By joining one of our teams, you'll directly impact these customers by transforming a traditionally frustrating experience into one that's fast, intuitive, and fair. Your code will help individuals and small businesses access global banking faster, enable entrepreneurs to pay international employees on time, and allow people like you and your teammates support their families across borders without friction. We're not just building verification systems – we're removing barriers that stand between our customers and their financial freedom.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own large\-sized, impactful projects within the domain. Your responsibilities span end\-to\-end:
   

  

 You will own the technical roadmap for your areas of ownership, ensuring they address important technical debt, reliability, scalability, and security concerns.
   

  

 You will be instrumental in designing and implementing robust backend systems that provide clean APIs and interfaces to hide the internal complexity.
   

  

 You will drive the integration with various risk and mitigation systems to ensure that Wise is compliant.
   

  

 You will take initiative to identify and solve impactful problems both within your team and beyond, contributing to high\-impact cross\-team initiatives.
   

  

**What We Expect From You**
 You have 6\+ years of experience working with Java 8\+, Spring framework, asynchronous message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and have architected and built highly scalable microservices.
   

  

 A strong product mindset and a deep passion for both customer experience and regulatory compliance.
   

  

 You will prioritize work with a holistic view of the customer and business impact, making data\-driven decisions to solve complex, ambiguous problems.
   

  

 Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and architectural concepts clearly to diverse audiences, including product managers, designers, and other engineering teams.
   

  

 You demonstrate a commitment to writing clean, testable, maintainable, and highly performant code, and you are a strong advocate for best coding practices and rigorous code reviews.
   

  

 Proven ability to identify and lead the technical delivery of large\-scale, organisationally\-complex projects, adept at anticipating and escalating organizational blockers.
   

  

 Extensive experience working with relational and non\-relational databases, including advanced query optimization, schema design, and data lifecycle management for sensitive information.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
